notes.title: Update Note For 1.0.9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The variety of stages has been enhanced again. Now, all maps feature more diverse enemy configurations.
[*] New Feature: "Catalog" Players can now access the Soul Orb Catalog, Amulet Catalog, and Ingredients Catalog via the Inventory.
[*] New Feature: "Voice Replay" After completing the main story, players will unlock a function that allows them to replay character voice lines.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For 1.0.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Increased variation in regular enemy stages. All maps now feature a wider variety of enemy configurations.
[*] Soul Orb Improvement: Taketora "Nioh" Soul Orb "Total Collapse" now increases base melee damage based on total shield amount.
[*] Adjusted Soul Power gain from certain mechanics.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Note For 1.0.7
notes.content:
Update:

[list]
[*] Improved the feel of Taketora's consecutive charged arrows, making it easier to chain charged shots.
[*] Soul Orb Upgrade: Taketora's weapon Nioh's Soul Orb "Always in the Fight" now also increases melee critical rate.
[*] Soul Orb Upgrade: Taketora's weapon Dancing Swells' Soul Orb “Vortex of the Sea” now increases melee attack speed for all weapons.
[*] Improved the random generation logic for Soul Orb.
[*] Improved the clarity and descriptions of Soul Orb effects.
[/list]
Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where salvaging Soul Orb could occasionally result in errors under certain conditions.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For 1.0.6
notes.content:
Update:
[list]
[*] Increased the amount of Soul Power obtained to help players build talents faster.
[*] Increased the attack frequency of the red ninja instructor in the tutorial to prevent players from falling asleep while waiting for him to warm up.
[*] Players now start with 3 Soul Orb refresh chances, allowing faster access to desired combinations.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could sometimes move outside the map boundaries during the boss fight with Mikoshi Nyudo.
[*] Fixed an issue where enemy position icons would sometimes remain on screen during story dialogue.
[*] Fixed an issue where stepping into water on certain maps would mistakenly trigger leaf splash effects instead of water splashes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the continuation of the Taketora Chapter's ending. Players who have already seen the ending can revisit it directly through the Story Review feature.
[*] After unlocking Taketora's ending, an additional Hidden Ending can now be triggered under specific conditions. Players who have already completed Taketora's route can also trigger this directly within their current playthrough.
[*] Adjusted the parry timing window for the final boss, [spoiler][b][u]Yasha of the Hundred Blades,[/u][/b][/spoiler] making it easier to achieve.
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update Dev Log: Vol. 1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Early Summer Dev Log – May 23, 2025[/b][/h2]
Hey everyone, this is 7QUARK.
Since the launch of Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade, we’ve been through quite the journey—ups and downs alike. But through it all, our team has been discussing and responding as quickly as we can.
Today, we’re excited to share some of the major updates coming soon:

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b][New Story Scene for Taketora Coming Soon][/b][/h3]
Many players have expressed their love for Taketora, our fluffy samurai, and their heartbreak over how his story played out. We’ve heard you loud and clear.
We’re adding a brand-new cutscene to his story arc—filling in the emotional gaps and bringing more closure to his tale. This update is set to roll out in about three days.
Hang in there. This part of the journey is worth the wait.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128844/3cf13e318ad5777616fd9192a718b03fbc10f6aa.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b][Sneak Peek: Shigure’s New Demon Blades][/b][/h3]
Don’t worry, Shigure’s got some love too.
Old man Hantetsusai has been forging day and night, and he’s finally crafted three brand-new demon blades—each with unique special effects and brand-new elemental traits not seen in the current system.
We’ve dropped demo videos for all three, so check them out and see how beautifully you can slice through demons!
[list]
[*] [b]Dreamy Butterfly[/b]: A crowd-control blade that summons enchanting illusions of butterflies.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128844/bdb6ce259a1389edf30caa871a22b73edc81c5d6.png[/img][previewyoutube=SikkzArLAe8;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] [b]Rising Phoenix[/b]: A dazzling, rainbow-colored blade that creates clones to launch surprise attacks.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128844/99a73e640494bc7d7ecef3855fb8791e1867c926.png[/img][previewyoutube=3QfL68u99D8;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] [b]Thunderbolt XVI[/b]: Packed with flashy lightning strikes and full-screen effects—perfect for players who love visual overload.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128844/b6d6209d9a6e239d3d625e003a29e570be195828.png[/img][previewyoutube=6JsUGw6dnp8;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b][Minion Stage Revamp: More Brutal, More Fun][/b][/h3]
We’ve also heard your feedback about the lack of variety in enemy waves—so we’re shaking things up.
[list]
[*] More randomness in small enemy encounters = more dynamic gameplay
[*] Starting from your second playthrough, enemies will be empowered by demonic energy, making each battle way more intense
[/list]The goal here is simple: [b]Make every fight more fun and challenging.[/b]
Worried about the difficulty? Don’t be.
We’re increasing the number of rerolls for your starter Soul Orbs, so you can build toward your ideal setup faster—no more praying to RNGesus (well, maybe just a little).

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b][Summer Swimsuit Skins Incoming][/b][/h3]
Summer’s almost here, and our heroes are getting into the season with some new outfits!
Even when battling demons, you gotta stay cool, right? (Okay yeah, some of the outfits might be a bit... light on fabric.)

We’re still deciding which versions to go with, so feel free to throw us some ideas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128844/6fb1ac415afb4a3e4aa19e65598fb25a4dd2f60a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128844/31b7819139a655407e1d0fc9863d0816f662e585.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128844/40d4e9a999fd4e9b38421133aecc4beb2a44bedd.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b][More Soul Power = Smoother Character Growth][/b][/h3]
We’re significantly increasing the Soul Power you earn from clearing stages. This means more flexibility at the Soul Shrine to shape your talents and builds.

[b][Coming Soon][/b] A reward system where the more characters you’ve completed the game with, the more Soul Power you earn. Let’s build those dream teams!

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b][Coming in the Next 3 Months: Free Updates][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Boss Rush Mode[/b]: Take on all bosses back-to-back in a survival-style challenge
[*] [b]Boss Battle Enhancements[/b]: Better mechanics, more intense fights
[*] [b]9 New Weapons[/b]: More styles, more options, more fun
[*] [b]New Demons[/b]: Enriching the small-stage monster ecosystem
[*] [b]New Talismans[/b]: More ways to build and customize your gear loadout
[/list]
[h3][b][Coming in the Next Year][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Route DLC – Yasha[/b]: A new playable character and storyline
[*] [b]Main Story Chapter 4[/b]: The next part of the protagonists’ journey
[*] [b]True Ending Arc[/b]: Unlockable after clearing Chapter 4 with any character
[*] [b]Superboss Versions of All Bosses[/b]: For those who want the ultimate challenge... Get ready.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Some Thoughts from the Devs[/b][/h2]
Working on Yasha: LDB has been a wild ride. We’ve faced a lot—miscommunication with players, gaps in our design philosophy, and realizing just how much more room we have to grow.

These lessons have been humbling but necessary. It’s clear to us now that we need to rethink how we develop—from the ground up.

Moving forward, we’re committed to being more responsive, more flexible, and more focused on what makes this game truly fun to play. This update is just the beginning.

We’ll keep fixing bugs, adding content, and improving every aspect of the experience. To everyone who’s supported us, given us feedback (both kind and harsh)—thank you.

We’re not done yet. Let’s keep making Yasha: LDB better, together.
[u][b] 7QUARK [/b][/u]

notes.title: Announcement of Operational Changes for Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade
notes.content:
The publisher of Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade, GSE, has unilaterally withdrawn from its role as the publisher on the Steam platform as of May 21, without any prior notice, communication, or coordination.
This unexpected move disregards the duties of a publisher and constitutes a serious breach of contract.

7QUARK will continue to maintain and support Yasha: LDB across all platforms, striving to improve the product.
(Support and updates will continue for both the Steam and console versions.)

As a result, starting May 22, 7QUARK will assume full operational responsibility for the Steam platform.
Our first action will be to adjust the global pricing to match Steam’s recommended regional pricing. We will no longer apply separate regional price adjustments.

[h3]The base price on Steam will be set at USD $13.99.[/h3]

Due to Steam’s restrictions on unofficial refund channels, players wishing to request a refund must go through Steam Support.
If you are unable to process a refund through Steam, 7QUARK will assist in communicating with the platform on your behalf.

Please note that publishing, sales, and pricing for console versions remain under GSE’s control. 7QUARK is not authorized to handle customer support for console platforms. We appreciate your understanding.

In the coming days, we will announce a short-term update roadmap for the game, including revisions to Taketora’s storyline.

— Sincerely,
The Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade Team at 7QUARK

notes.title: Update Notes For 1.0.4
notes.content:
Update:

[list]
[*] Added constant display for Inferno Scroll difficulty level.
[*] Added feature to dismantle Soul Orbs for money.
[*] Added new enemy aura types: "Ice" and "Water".
[*] Improved Shigure’s "Grand Mystic Artes" by shortening dash cancel delay.
[*] Enhanced Sara’s weapon "Spring Dango" to spawn more dango and make them easier to interact with.
[*] Improved the charge speed effect of the legendary ramen "Clear Mirror, Still Water".
[*] Buffed some amulets with previously low stats.
[*] Adjusted Shigure’s weapon "Undying Cuckoo" to fix an issue where energy might not be properly gained.
[*] Adjusted Takeko’s weapon "Sunset" so the meteor effect no longer lingers too long, blocking enemy actions.
[*] Adjusted the explosion effect for 5 stacks of "Burn" to reduce screen-blocking duration.
[*] Corrected some text errors in the Inferno Scroll descriptions.
[*] Adjusted damage values of certain weapons with abnormal output.
[/list]
Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain attacks from the boss Mikoshi Nyudo could lock player controls.
[*] Fixed an issue where some attacks from Mikoshi Nyudo could prevent the player’s death animation from playing properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the boss Nine-Tailed Fox might not drop rewards upon defeat.
[*] Fixed an issue where Shigure's "Grand Mystic Artes" might fail to deal damage.
[*] Fixed overlapping background music in Story Viewing Mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For 1.0.3
notes.content:
Updates:

[list]
[*] Improved the sorting method of the "Backer List" to make names clearer and easier to read.
[*] Added fast-scrolling functionality to the "Credits" screen.
[/list]
Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where improper shutdowns could result in corrupted save data.
[*]Fixed a bug where certain Steam achievements might not trigger correctly.
[/list]

notes.content: Fixed an issue where possessing a certain number of amulets could cause the game to crash during the final stage.

notes.title: [Announcement] Official Launch on May 14 at 9:00 PM PST!
notes.content:

Hello everyone, we’re 7QUARK.

The time has finally come! After what feels like forever, Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade is ready for its TRUE OFFICIAL LAUNCH.

[b][u]The game will be available for purchase starting May 14 (Wed), 9:00 PM PST.[/u][/b]

We’ve just released the final Gameplay Trailer, showcasing footage from the completed version. Be sure to check it out!

But that’s not the end — development continues post-launch! We’re hard at work on the new content promised during our Kickstarter campaign, including:
[list]
[*] Six new weapons for each protagonist: Shigure, Sara, and Taketora
[*] Boss Rush mode
[*] And something we just had to do… all-new character outfits
[/list] ...and more.


To celebrate the release, an animated PV will also premiere on YouTube at launch.
This piece was brought to life by [b]Bandai Namco Pictures[/b].

Hello everyone, here's 7QUARK.

During our Kickstarter campaign, we released the v1.0 demo, and we were truly grateful for the overwhelming support that so many players joined the playtest and helped us squash bugs!

To prepare for the Steam Next Fest, we temporarily took down the demo after the campaign ended and made major updates.

What’s new in v2.0:
[list]
[*]The first half of Chapter 1 of the main story
[*]More NPC side conversations
[*]A new scenic stage: Autumn Mountain Path
[*]A new boss stage: Komainu
[*]And... some "Defeat CGs" of Shigure, Sara, and Taketora that we just couldn’t resist drawing!

lus, we’d love to introduce our amazing partner: [u][b]Mononoke No Kuni[/b][/u]

Thanks to their expertise in crafting Japanese-style narratives, Japanese players can now enjoy a more immersive and authentic text experience.

If you love our game, we’re sure you’ll also enjoy the stunning classical Japanese aesthetic of Mononoke no Kuni. Add it to your wishlist and support this fantastic indie team!
